source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 4 (PDF 49-63), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Development of Graphical User Interface (GUI)) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
4.1 Graphical User Interface (GUI) Development with Tkinter

blocks.prompt:
1 Compared with command-line interfaces, GUIs make applications:
(Command-line interfaces ke muqable mein GUIs applications ko kaisa banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: GUIs applications ko command-line ke muqable mein zyada user-friendly aur aasan banate hain.

book_ref.quote: GUIs make applications more user-friendly and easier to use compared to command-line interfaces.

blocks.prompt:
2 GUI development allows programs to interact with users through:
(GUI development programs ko users se kis ke zariye rabta karne deti hai?)

options.text: windows, buttons, labels aur text boxes jaise visual elements

blocks.explanation: GUI mein program windows, buttons, labels aur text boxes jaise nazar aane wale elements se user se rabta karta hai.

book_ref.quote: allows programs to interact with users through visual elements like windows, buttons, labels, and text boxes

blocks.prompt:
3 GUIs improve usability by:
(GUIs usability (istemal mein aasani) kaise behtar karte hain?)

options.text: visual feedback de kar aur pechida commands yaad rakhne ki zaroorat kam kar ke

blocks.explanation: GUIs nazar aane wala jawab (visual feedback) dete hain aur pechida commands yaad rakhne ki zaroorat kam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They improve usability by providing visual feedback and reducing the need to remember complex commands.

blocks.prompt:
4 GUIs are especially helpful for which users, according to the chapter?
(Chapter ke mutabiq GUIs khaas tor par kin users ke liye mufeed hain?)
blocks.explanation: GUIs programs ko samajhna aur chalana aasan banate hain, khaas tor par ghair technical users ke liye.

book_ref.quote: especially for non-technical users

blocks.prompt:
5 GUI applications are widely used in:
(GUI applications kahan zyada istemal hoti hain?)

options.text: desktop software, web applications aur mobile apps

blocks.explanation: GUI applications desktop software, web applications aur mobile apps mein aam hain.

book_ref.quote: GUI applications are widely used in desktop software, web applications, and mobile apps.

blocks.prompt:
6 Which statement about installing Tkinter is correct?
(Tkinter install karne ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: yeh sirf MySQL ke saath chalta hai
yeh Python ke saath pehle se install hota hai
yeh sirf mobile par install hota hai

blocks.explanation: Tkinter Python ka standard GUI toolkit hai jo Python ke saath pehle se install hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Tkinter is Python's standard GUI toolkit that comes pre-installed with the language.

blocks.prompt:
7 Tkinter is suitable for building:
(Tkinter kis qism ki applications banane ke liye munasib hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tkinter aasan aur halka hai aur chhoti se darmiyani GUI applications jaldi banane ke liye munasib hai.

book_ref.quote: It is suitable for building small to medium-sized GUI applications quickly and efficiently.

blocks.prompt:
8 Tkinter provides a set of ______ to create windows, buttons, labels and entry fields.
(Tkinter windows, buttons, labels aur entry fields banane ke liye kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tkinter windows aur widgets banane ke liye classes aur functions ka set deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It provides a set of classes and functions to create windows, buttons, labels, entry fields

blocks.prompt:
9 In a Tkinter program, which statement creates the main window?
(Tkinter program mein main window kaun sa statement banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tk() main window banata hai; Label text dikhata, Entry input leta aur mainloop() GUI chalata hai.

book_ref.quote: Tk() → creates main window

blocks.prompt:
10 What is the job of window.mainloop() at the end of a Tkinter program?
(Tkinter program ke aakhir mein window.mainloop() ka kya kaam hai?)

options.text: yeh tamam widgets delete karta hai

blocks.explanation: mainloop() GUI chalata hai: window khuli rehti aur user ke events ka intezar karti hai.

book_ref.quote: mainloop() → runs the GUI

blocks.prompt:
11 Which pair of features of Tkinter is given in the chapter?
(Chapter mein Tkinter ki kaun si do khoobiyan di gayi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tkinter seekhne mein aasan, halka (lightweight) hai aur event-driven programming support karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Tkinter is easy to learn, lightweight, and supports event-driven programming

blocks.prompt:
12 In the chapter's simple GUI example, the function on_click() runs label.config(text="Button Clicked!"). What does config() do here?
(Chapter ki simple GUI misal mein on_click() label.config(text="Button Clicked!") chalata hai. config() yahan kya karta hai?)

options.text: label ka dikhaya gaya text badalta hai

blocks.explanation: config() maujooda widget ka option badalta hai; yahan button dabane par label ka text "Button Clicked!" ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: command=on_click → event handling (button click)

blocks.prompt:
13 In Tkinter, the components that help build interactive graphical applications are called:
(Tkinter mein woh components jo interactive graphical applications banate hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tkinter ke components widgets kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: Tkinter provides many components, called widgets

blocks.prompt:
14 According to the chapter, a complete interface is created by:
(Chapter ke mutabiq mukammal interface kaise banta hai?)

options.text: widgets ko mila kar, har aik apne maqsad ke saath

blocks.explanation: Har widget ka apna maqsad hai aur inhein mila kar mukammal interface banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each widget has its own purpose, and combining them creates a complete interface.

blocks.prompt:
15 A Tkinter program begins by creating the:
(Tkinter program kis cheez ko bana kar shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tkinter program main window bana kar shuru hota hai jo baqi tamam elements ki bunyad hai.

book_ref.quote: A Tkinter program begins by creating a main window, which serves as the base for all other elements.

blocks.prompt:
16 Sections within a Tkinter window that help organize and group related widgets are called:
(Tkinter window ke andar woh hisse jo mutaliqa widgets ko group karte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Frames window ke andar hisse hain jo use chhote hisson mein baant kar widgets ko group karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Frames are sections within the window that help organize content.

blocks.prompt:
17 In the statement window.geometry("400x300"), what do 400 and 300 give?
(window.geometry("400x300") mein 400 aur 300 kya batate hain?)

options.text: button ki x aur y position

blocks.explanation: geometry() window ka size, chaurai x unchai, set karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The window can be resized, given a title, and designed to hold different widgets.

blocks.prompt:
18 In the frames example, bottom_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True) makes the bottom frame:
(Frames ki misal mein bottom_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True) bottom frame ko kya karta hai?)

options.text: baqi jagah dono taraf bhar dena

blocks.explanation: fill="both" aur expand=True se frame baqi jagah dono taraf bhar deta hai; top_frame fill="x" se sirf chaurai mein phailta hai.

book_ref.quote: Frames divide the window into smaller parts, making it easier to group related widgets.

blocks.prompt:
19 Which widget allows the user to perform an action when it is clicked?
(Kaun sa widget click karne par user ko koi amal karne deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Button click karne par koi amal (action) karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A Button allows the user to perform an action when it is clicked.

blocks.prompt:
20 Which widget provides a list of options at the top of the window?
(Kaun sa widget window ke upar options ki list deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Menu window ke upar options ki list deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A Menu provides a list of options at the top of the window.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which widget shows a list of items and allows the user to select from it?
(Kaun sa widget items ki list dikhata aur us mein se chunne deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Listbox items ki list dikhata aur chunne deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A Listbox shows a list of items and allows selection from the list.

blocks.prompt:
22 Which of the following is NOT a Tkinter widget named in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa chapter mein bataya gaya Tkinter widget NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke widgets: Label, Button, Entry, Menu, Listbox (aur Frame). Cursor database ka object hai jo SQL commands chalata hai.

book_ref.quote: Widgets are the basic elements used to build a graphical user interface.

blocks.prompt:
23 An Entry field is created with tk.Entry(window, show="*") and the user types 1234. What does the field display, and what does get() return?
(tk.Entry(window, show="*") wala Entry field hai aur user 1234 type karta hai. Field kya dikhata hai aur get() kya deta hai?)

options.text: it displays nothing and get() returns nothing

blocks.explanation: show="*" sirf screen par huroof chhupata hai (password ke liye); get() phir bhi asal text 1234 deta hai.

book_ref.quote: An Entry field is used to enter text, such as a name or password.

blocks.prompt:
24 Layout management decides which two things about each widget?
(Layout management har widget ke bare mein kaun si do cheezein tay karta hai?)

options.text: screen par us ki jagah aur size

blocks.explanation: Layout management har widget ki jagah (position) aur size tay karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It decides the position and size of each widget on the screen.

blocks.prompt:
25 Proper layout management helps applications to:
(Achhi layout management applications ki kya madad karti hai?)

options.text: saaf suthri dikhna aur har screen size par theek chalna

blocks.explanation: Tidbit: achhi layout management applications ko saaf suthra aur mukhtalif screen sizes par theek chalne wala banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Proper layout management helps make applications look neat and work well on different screen sizes.

blocks.prompt:
26 Which layout method arranges widgets in rows and columns like a table?
(Kaun sa layout method widgets ko table ki tarah rows aur columns mein rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: grid() widgets ko rows aur columns mein table ki tarah rakhta hai; forms ke liye mufeed hai.

book_ref.quote: The grid() method arranges widgets in rows and columns like a table.

blocks.prompt:
27 A student wants to make a form with labels in one column and entry fields beside them. Which method is most useful?
(Talib-e-ilm aik form banana chahta hai jis mein labels aik column mein aur un ke saath entry fields hon. Kaun sa method sab se mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: grid() forms aur munazzam layouts ke liye mufeed hai kyunke widgets rows aur columns mein rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is useful for forms and structured layouts.

blocks.prompt:
28 Which layout method is easy to use and works well for small applications, placing widgets in a simple vertical or horizontal order?
(Kaun sa layout method aasan hai, chhoti applications ke liye acha hai aur widgets ko seedhi upar neeche ya daayen baayen tarteeb mein rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: pack() widgets ko saada upar neeche ya daayen baayen rakhta hai; aasan aur chhoti applications ke liye acha hai.

book_ref.quote: It is easy to use and works well for small applications.

blocks.prompt:
29 Which statement about the place() method is correct?
(place() method ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: yeh zyada control deta hai magar ehtiyat se adjust karna parta hai
yeh widgets ko rows aur columns mein rakhta hai
yeh theek jagah set nahin kar sakta

blocks.explanation: place() widgets ko bilkul theek jagah rakhta hai; zyada control deta hai magar ehtiyat se adjust karna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: It gives more control but needs careful adjustment.

blocks.prompt:
30 In the statement submit.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=2), the button:
(submit.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=2) mein button kya karta hai?)

options.text: doosri row aur aik column mein
teesri row mein aur do columns par phaila hua

blocks.explanation: Rows aur columns 0 se shuru hote hain, is liye row=2 teesri row hai; columnspan=2 button ko do columns par phaila deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The grid() method arranges widgets in rows and columns like a table.

blocks.prompt:
31 What does ok.place(x=50, y=120) do?
(ok.place(x=50, y=120) kya karta hai?)

options.text: button ko 50 chaura aur 120 uncha banata hai
button ko 50 padding se pack karta hai
button ko window ke baayen se 50 aur upar se 120 pixels par rakhta hai

blocks.explanation: place() widget ko theek jagah rakhta hai: x baayen kinare se aur y upar ke kinare se faasla hai.

book_ref.quote: The place() method positions widgets at exact locations on the window

blocks.prompt:
32 In the book's pack() example, button1.pack(pady=10) is used. What does pady=10 add?
(Kitab ki pack() misal mein button1.pack(pady=10) hai. pady=10 kya shamil karta hai?)

options.text: button ke upar aur neeche 10 pixels jagah

blocks.explanation: pady upar neeche jagah (padding) deta hai, is liye teeno buttons aik doosre ke neeche faasle se aate hain.

book_ref.quote: The pack() method places widgets in a simple vertical or horizontal order.

blocks.prompt:
33 Interfaces that adjust their layout when the window size changes are called:
(Jo interfaces window ka size badalne par apni layout badal lein, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Responsive interfaces window ka size badalne par layout badal lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Responsive interfaces adjust their layout when the window size changes.

blocks.prompt:
34 Which feature describes a clean interface?
(Kaun si khoobi clean (saaf) interface ki hai?)

options.text: achhi tarteeb wale widgets jin ke darmiyan kaafi jagah ho

blocks.explanation: Clean interface mein widgets achhi tarteeb mein aur un ke darmiyan kaafi jagah hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A clean interface has well-arranged widgets and enough space between them.

blocks.prompt:
35 According to the chapter, what improves the overall look of an application?
(Chapter ke mutabiq application ki majmooi shakal kis se behtar hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Durust alignment (seedh) application ki shakal behtar banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Proper alignment improves the overall look of the application.

blocks.prompt:
36 In event handling, an event is:
(Event handling mein event kya hai?)

options.text: aik amal, jaise button click ya text type karna

blocks.explanation: Event aik amal hai, jaise button click karna ya text type karna.

book_ref.quote: An event is an action, such as clicking a button or typing text.

blocks.prompt:
37 In event handling, the program:
(Event handling mein program kya karta hai?)

options.text: har waqt chalne ke bajaye event ka intezar karta hai
sara code aik baar chala kar ruk jata hai
user ke amal nazar andaz karta hai
shuru hone ke liye database chahiye

blocks.explanation: Program har waqt chalne ke bajaye event ka intezar karta hai; event hone par khaas kaam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The program waits for an event instead of running all the time.

blocks.prompt:
38 In event-driven programming, what does the program do until an event occurs?
(Event-driven programming mein event hone tak program kya karta hai?)

options.text: khud ko dobara shuru karta hai

blocks.explanation: Event hone tak program khali (idle) rehta hai; is se system ke wasail bachte hain.

book_ref.quote: The program remains idle until an event occurs.

blocks.prompt:
39 One advantage of event-driven programming given in the chapter is that it:
(Chapter mein event-driven programming ka aik faida kya hai?)

options.text: sirf GUI ke baghair chalta hai

blocks.explanation: Program event tak idle rehta hai aur function sirf event par chalta hai, is liye system ke wasail bachte hain.

book_ref.quote: This approach saves system resources.

blocks.prompt:
40 Which of the following are common events named in the chapter?
(In mein se chapter ke bataye gaye aam events kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aam events button clicks aur key presses hain; har event aik khaas function se jura hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Each event is linked to a specific function.

blocks.prompt:
41 When a widget connected to a function is used, what happens?
(Jab function se jura widget istemal ho to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Widget function se jura hota hai; widget istemal hone par woh function chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: When the widget is used, the connected function executes.

blocks.prompt:
42 In the login form, the entered username is read with entry_user.get(). What does get() return?
(Login form mein entry_user.get() se username parha jata hai. get() kya deta hai?)

options.text: entry field mein type kiya gaya text

blocks.explanation: get() entry field mein type kiya gaya text deta hai; check_login() use sahi username se milata hai.

book_ref.quote: Entry fields are used to take the input from the user.

blocks.prompt:
43 In the login form, which module shows the success or error message?
(Login form mein kamyabi ya ghalti ka paigham kaun sa module dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: check_login() ke baad messagebox kamyabi (showinfo) ya ghalti (showerror) dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: When the button is clicked, the program checks the entered data.

blocks.prompt:
44 A login program checks: if username == "student" and password == "pass99". The user types username student and password pass90 and clicks Login. Which message box appears?
(Login program check karta hai: if username == "student" and password == "pass99". User student aur pass90 likh kar Login dabata hai. Kaun sa message box aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: and mein dono sharten sach honi chahiyein; password pass90 pass99 se nahin milta, is liye else wala showerror chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: A message is then shown for success or error.

blocks.prompt:
45 A program has label = tk.Label(window, text="Enter your name") and a Greet button whose function runs label.config(text="Hello, " + entry.get()). The user types Ayesha and clicks Greet. What does the label now show?
(Program mein label = tk.Label(window, text="Enter your name") hai aur Greet button ka function label.config(text="Hello, " + entry.get()) chalata hai. User Ayesha likh kar Greet dabata hai. Label ab kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Button dabane par function chalta hai: get() Ayesha deta hai aur config() label ka text "Hello, Ayesha" kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, a button click can display a message.

blocks.prompt:
46 Python programs connect to databases to:
(Python programs databases se kis liye jurte hain?)

options.text: data insert, retrieve, update aur delete karna

blocks.explanation: Python programs database se jur kar data insert, retrieve, update aur delete karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Python programs can connect to databases to insert, retrieve, update, and delete data.

blocks.prompt:
47 Using databases helps maintain data:
(Databases ka istemal data ki kya barqarar rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Databases data ki durustagi (accuracy) aur yaksaniyat (consistency) barqarar rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Using databases helps maintain data accuracy and consistency.

blocks.prompt:
48 An organized collection of data stored in a structured format is called a:
(Munazzam shakal mein rakha gaya data ka majmooa kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Database data ka munazzam majmooa hai.

book_ref.quote: A database is an organized collection of data stored in a structured format.

blocks.prompt:
49 Which is an advantage of databases given in the chapter?
(Chapter mein databases ka kaun sa faida diya gaya hai?)

options.text: yeh data ka dohrao (duplication) kam karte hain
yeh sirf GUI ke saath chalte hain

blocks.explanation: Databases data ka dohrao kam aur aitbaar zyada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Databases reduce data duplication and improve reliability.

blocks.prompt:
50 A real-world object, person, place, event or concept about which data is stored in a database is called a(n):
(Haqeeqi duniya ki cheez, shakhs, jagah, waqia ya tasawwur jis ke bare mein database mein data rakha jaye, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Entity woh haqeeqi cheez ya shakhs hai jis ka data rakha jaye, jaise Student, Teacher, Course.

book_ref.quote: An entity is a real-world object, person, place, event, or concept about which data is stored

blocks.prompt:
51 For the entity Student, Roll Number, Class and Age are examples of:
(Entity Student ke liye Roll Number, Class aur Age kis ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Attribute entity ki khoobi hai; Student Name, Roll Number, Class aur Age Student ke attributes hain.

book_ref.quote: An attribute is a property or characteristic of an entity.

blocks.prompt:
52 In "A Student enrols in a Course", the words "enrols in" are a(n):
("A Student enrols in a Course" mein "enrols in" kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Relationship batata hai ke entities aapas mein kaise juri hain; enrols in Student aur Course ka relationship hai.

book_ref.quote: Here, enrols in is the relationship between Student and Course.

blocks.prompt:
53 Why can Roll Number be used as an identifier for the entity Student?
(Roll Number ko Student ka identifier kyun banaya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: kai talaba ka aik roll number hota hai
har talib-e-ilm ka roll number munfarid hota hai

blocks.explanation: Identifier har record ko alag pehchanta hai; har talib-e-ilm ka roll number munfarid (unique) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: An identifier is an attribute that uniquely identifies each record or object of an entity.

blocks.prompt:
54 Which of these is an entity, NOT an attribute?
(In mein se kaun si entity hai, attribute NAHIN?)
blocks.explanation: Student, Teacher, Course, Book, Employee entities hain; Age, Roll Number, Student Name attributes hain.

book_ref.quote: Example: Student, Teacher, Course, Book, Employee

blocks.prompt:
55 In a table, rows are also called ______ and columns are also called ______.
(Table mein rows ko kya aur columns ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table mein rows records aur columns fields kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: Table: A collection of related data organised in rows (records) and columns (fields).

blocks.prompt:
56 A unique identifier for each record in a table is the:
(Table ke har record ki munfarid pehchan kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary key table ke har record ki munfarid pehchan hai.

book_ref.quote: Primary Key: A unique identifier for each record in a table.

blocks.prompt:
57 A field that links one table to another by referring to the primary key of the other table is a:
(Woh field jo doosre table ki primary key ka hawala de kar tables ko jorti hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Foreign key doosre table ki primary key ka hawala de kar tables ko jorti hai.

book_ref.quote: A field that links one table to another by referring to the primary key of another table.

blocks.prompt:
58 In a database table, "name" and "age" are examples of:
(Database table mein "name" aur "age" kis ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Column entity ki khoobi hai, jaise name, age.

book_ref.quote: Column: A property or characteristic of an entity (e.g., name, age).

blocks.prompt:
59 What is required before performing any data operation from Python?
(Python se koi bhi data operation karne se pehle kya zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi bhi data operation se pehle database connection zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: A database connection is required before performing any data operation.

blocks.prompt:
60 Proper connection handling ensures:
(Connection ko theek sambhalna kya yaqeeni banata hai?)

options.text: Python aur database ke darmiyan hamwar rabta

blocks.explanation: Connection theek sambhalne se Python aur database ka rabta hamwar rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Once connected, data can be added, retrieved, or modified.

blocks.prompt:
61 In a relational database, relationships between tables are maintained using:
(Relational database mein tables ke darmiyan taluq kis se qaim rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Relational database mein tables ka taluq keys se qaim rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Relationships between tables are maintained using keys.

blocks.prompt:
62 SQL stands for:
(SQL ka poora naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: SQL yani Structured Query Language, databases se rabta karne ki zaban.

book_ref.quote: SQL stands for Structured Query Language and is used to interact with databases.

blocks.prompt:
63 Which library is built into Python and used for small databases?
(Kaun si library Python mein pehle se maujood hai aur chhote databases ke liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: sqlite3 Python mein built-in hai aur chhote databases ke liye hai; data aik file mein rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The sqlite3 library is built into Python and is used for small databases.

blocks.prompt:
64 MySQL is used for:
(MySQL kis ke liye istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: MySQL bade aur pechida database systems ke liye hai, jabke sqlite3 chhote databases ke liye.

book_ref.quote: MySQL is used for larger and more complex database systems.

blocks.prompt:
65 An sqlite3 database stores its data:
(sqlite3 database apna data kahan rakhta hai?)

options.text: in a single file on the system

blocks.explanation: sqlite3 data system par aik file mein rakhta hai, jaise school.db.

book_ref.quote: It stores data in a single file on the system.

blocks.prompt:
66 In the statement connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db"), what happens if school.db does not exist?
(connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db") mein agar school.db maujood na ho to kya hota hai?)

options.text: SQLite file khud bana deta hai

blocks.explanation: Connection database ka naam de kar banta hai; sqlite3 mein file na ho to SQLite khud bana deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A connection is created by providing database details such as name and credentials.

blocks.prompt:
67 In an sqlite3 program, the cursor object is used to:
(sqlite3 program mein cursor object kis liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: cursor = connection.cursor() SQL commands chalane ke liye cursor object banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Create Cursor: Creates a cursor object to execute SQL commands.

blocks.prompt:
68 Which method returns all the records produced by a SELECT query as a list of rows?
(Kaun sa method SELECT query ke tamam records rows ki list ki shakal mein deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: fetchall() rows ki list deta hai; program loop se har row print karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Fetch and Display Data: Fetches all records and prints each row in the result.
